landing.featuresSectionTitle:
Many stock apps exist.
But none actually
diagnose your portfolio.
landing.featuresSectionDesc: Charts are everywhere — but no one tells you if your portfolio is actually healthy.
landing.feature1Desc: Analyzes diversification, sector bias, and volatility to deliver a daily 0–100 score.
landing.feature2Desc: Suggests concrete actions like "Reduce Samsung from 50% → 25%" and simulates the impact.
landing.feature3Desc: Get a browser notification the moment something significant changes in your portfolio.
landing.feature4Desc: Only news relevant to your holdings — filtered out everything else.

landing.notif2Bold: IT sector is 71% of your portfolio
